market_view: Mega-cap tech is breaking down on AI-capex worries (Nasdaq -1.38%, GOOGL -12.6%, AMZN -6% after hours) while equal-weight, health care and financials rally; Friday brings the ECI, Chicago PMI and XOM/CVX/ABBV pre-open.
lessons: Concentration in AI megacaps cost me: GOOGL stopped out at -17.7% and AMZN is gapping below its stop after hours, while my diversifiers LLY (+5.1%) and BLK (+3.3%) are the winners, so any new compounder must be outside AI capex.
